_doc: Per vector: where the version 6 prototype reads the inputs differently from version 7, as the author recorded it.

vectors.2099-judgment: v6 agrees on verdicts, RJ06, reason, debt and expiresInDays; its debt row has no 'exceptions' field (version 7 adds it, A.7.7.1), so that fields assertion fails on v6.
vectors.allowed-hatch-at-boundary: v6 raises a preexisting sound contradiction at Host::send from its Hatch clause dc8454f26ba4a098 (ob:220a9b307f0f3608): owed in change mode and blocking in audit mode, so the verdicts are owed and blocked instead of pass.
vectors.append-only-update: v6's std AppendOnly forbids only HardDelete (↓HardDelete excludes Update and Redact), so all three cases pass with 0 obligations in v6 (agent/E6); the forbid's fp also differs (v6 ccfcbabf…).
vectors.approve-without-exception: v6 agrees on the two Example 2 obligations (keys, bindings, group, severities) but also raises a preexisting owed contradiction at HostTrusted's external_body marker from its Hatch clause (ob:220a9b307f0f3608, fp dc8454f26ba4a098); its debt rows lack 'exceptions'.
vectors.attribute-macro-out-dir-include: v6 passes all three cases (no hatch(rust) channel: v6 std declares unsafe in bend only); v7 raises coverage in the first two.
vectors.barrel-import: v6's judgment Req holds u alone: the helper edit is stale but preexisting (introduced false) and both stale bindings cover only (u, unit) (bd:ebfa122620a961df, bd:93b72fc0da94f45f); verdicts and the control agree.
vectors.base-failing-law-counterexample: v6 has no counterexample clause: all three cases are introduced and blocking in v6; v7 makes equal-counterexample-other-seed preexisting and owed.
vectors.base-totality: v6 agrees on unreadable-base (L0 key, binding, tier critical, blocking) and on the head E-unbound; in base-shape-errors and head-shape-error it also raises an owed coverage obligation for component m::K (unobservable channel), so base-shape-errors is owed in v6 instead of pass.
vectors.callee-bug-unit-law: v6 keeps the contradiction preexisting and owed in callee-edited (introducedness by Req only), so the verdict is owed instead of blocked; key and binding agree.
vectors.cell-pairs-universe: v6 agrees on loosening keys, affected positions (the universe cell included) and bindings; its 'order' is null where version 7 outputs the class (A.8.1.3, D17).
vectors.code-moved-lower-tier: v6 passes moved-by-glob with no obligation (its Lvl counts effect forbids only) and prints order null; in kept-in-vault it agrees on the coverage key, tier and severity, but its binding bd:99112f22e5d3293f has no delta, where version 7 adds the '<claim fp> <channel>' pair (A.7.2.2).
vectors.coverage-binding-pairs: v6 hashes coverage bindings with an empty delta (lawyer/L41), so both unmet-pair cases share v6 binding and the old answer would discharge; v6 also fails to discharge in two-unmet-pairs-answered because the v7 ref expands to no v6 binding.
vectors.deleted-unit: v6 raises its retired L2 question (summary removed, undecided, blocking) in file-and-unit-deleted and file-unit-and-law-deleted, so file-and-unit-deleted is blocked in v6 instead of pass; the L4 key and binding agree.
vectors.dependency-macro: same: v6 also raises blocking critical coverage on DelegationMap from hatchComplete false, but its binding omits the (claim, channel) pair (v6 bd:3b717bfe…, v7 delta ["<fp> hatch(verus)"]).
vectors.directory-move: v6 has no relocation: the moved f is a new identity and a finest change, its assume fact is new, and moved-unedited is blocked in v6 (introduced, binding with code [(new f, own, null, head)]; anvil a27a5959). moved-and-edited agrees with v6, binding included.
vectors.dropped-harness: same, except the record-present binding: v6 omits the harness test/run.test.ts own digests that A.16.19 adds to code
vectors.empty-req: v6 raises an owed preexisting unestablished(missing) obligation for the law on the empty component (Req = ∅ is not treated as vacuous). In the control v6 agrees on the obligation and on exception, owner and 37 days, but its debt row has no `exceptions` list (v7 A.12.10.1).
vectors.equal-fp-merge: same: v6 merges per A.4.1.7 (owner merge::TeamZ, then merge::TeamA), with the same key and binding.
vectors.fact-without-n: v6 reads a missing n as 1: sound-base-without-n is preexisting and owed (v7: base record rejected RJ14, fact new, blocking) and heuristic-without-n is not introduced (v7: introduced). v6 raises no RJ14. The n-present cases agree.
vectors.final-coverage-one-person-team: v6 never discharges here because its coverage binding has an empty delta, so the v7 ref expands to nothing; both cases are blocked in v6. (Under v6's per-binding answers a single bob answer to the v6 binding was the completeness-review gap D11 closes.)
vectors.final-drift-tier-lowered: v6 blocks all three cases: it applies rule 2 to non-introduced final contradictions (unrelated-change and tier-lowered-answered are blocked by the drift, tier final), whereas v7 rule 2 needs an introduced contradiction; v6 keeps tier final after the two-person answer (v7: critical). v6 computes the same contradiction key/binding and the same loosening key/binding/questions (it discharged the loosening with the v7 ref).
vectors.final-law-admit: v6 passes final-law (its rule names only assume), so version 7 must block where v6 passes.
vectors.final-law-single-judgment: v6 passes one-person and person-and-agent: it establishes the final law with any single eligible judgment and lets an agent judge when critical's judges list agents (lawyer/L06). no-judgment and two-persons agree.
vectors.full-profile-blob-ids: v6 has no full profile: it reads head.source only and reports every input of this vector invalid (measured 2026-10-29), so only the assertions that expect invalid pass on v6.
vectors.full-profile-manifest-identity: v6 has no full profile: it reads head.source only and reports every input of this vector invalid (measured 2026-10-29), so only the assertions that expect invalid pass on v6.
vectors.full-profile-pack-pins: v6 has no full profile: it reads head.source only and reports every input of this vector invalid (measured 2026-10-29), so only the assertions that expect invalid pass on v6.
vectors.full-profile-parse-failure: v6 has no full profile: it reads head.source only and reports every input of this vector invalid (measured 2026-10-29), so only the assertions that expect invalid pass on v6.
vectors.guard-helper-edit: v6 reports stale but preexisting and owed in helper-edited, with a binding over (isoToday, unit) alone (bd:2933955cc8034c8b), since its Req holds isoToday only; verdict owed instead of blocked.
vectors.head-drops-absence: same verdicts and obligations as v6 (coverage AuditStore final blocking plus the undecided final L7 on the provider); v6's coverage binding has an empty delta (v7 lists the forbid and authority pairs).
vectors.head-only-provider: v6 reproduces the L03 attack: the head-only record (implementation src/** meets Δcode) makes the reason an answerable producer-changed whose binding equals version 7's missing-reason binding (affected [run]), so the approve line discharges it and v6 passes head-only-record-and-approve; version 7 stays blocked with reason missing. The control agrees, binding included.
vectors.hosted-closure-weakened: v6 treats the equal-NF head law as an heir and ignores the closure digest (agent/W6), so closure-moved passes with no L4 in v6; closure-equal agrees.
vectors.in-tree-non-builtin-macro: v6's std declares unsafe only in bend, so unsafe<Trust> has no hatch(rust) channel and both cases pass in v6 (v7: std declares unsafe in rust, A.3.4.3, D20, and dependency-function-macro is blocked by coverage).
vectors.include-in-tree-literal: same: v6 raises the same introduced blocking contradiction from the manifest's markers at parse (the marker counting is the manifest builder's, so the checker sees identical inputs); the control agrees.
vectors.judge-line-without-relay: v6 turns the judge line into a judgment for the run and passes judge-line (Example 3 Step 1 behaviour); v7 keeps the obligation (owed). The control agrees.
vectors.judges-narrowing-no-fallback: v6 accepts tim's self answer in both cases (fallback computed under policy*), so base-judges-name-bob passes in v6 instead of being blocked; the producer-changed binding differs: v6 omits bunfig.toml's own digests, which A.16.19 adds to code, so the review ref (version 7's prefix) expands to nothing in v6 and base-judges-owner-only stays blocked there.
vectors.moved-harness-stale: v6 reads the moved harness digest as producer-changed, introduced and blocking at critical (bd:1eb4c1ae71081380), so harness-digest-moved is blocked in v6 instead of owed.
vectors.new-call-existing-edge: v6 marks the contradiction introduced in call-on-existing-edge too (newness per fact) and raises an owed coverage obligation for component checker::ShapeModelLowerer in both cases, which joins the group (v6 g:cff8c48d99f86f3b); the bindings agree.
vectors.off-path-cycle: v6 agrees on key, introducedness, bindings (all five edges) and witness; in new-off-path-edge it adds an owed coverage obligation for component m::X that version 7 does not raise (D3).
vectors.producer-change-assumption: v6 reports producer-changed in assume-and-lockfile-bump-approved (the assumption is masked, binding bd:5e7f5ad7af70dc94 with Cargo.lock); the approve line names version 7's binding prefix, which expands to nothing in v6, so v6 is still blocked there. The two lockfile-only cases agree except the producer-changed binding: v6 omits Cargo.lock's own digests, which A.16.19 adds to code, so in lockfile-bump-approved the ref expands to nothing in v6.
vectors.provider-channels-claim-tier: v6 gives clockScan's L7 subject tier normal (blocking under DefaultPolicy) instead of low (owed); the control agrees (final, blocking). The kernel's version 6 over-approximation would give final (lawyer/L38 (4)).
vectors.provider-direction: v6 keys the contradiction under its own AppendOnly (forbid HardDelete<AuditEvent>, ob:bb51a88f52f5081e) instead of version 7's forbid Update (D13, ob:98ff6f5f02010232); its L7 key, tier and severity agree; its coverage binding bd:1659f0c4216254b4 has the same affected and code but no delta, where version 7 adds the two '<claim fp> <channel>' pairs (A.7.2.2, D22).
vectors.raw-hashbang-executable: v6 also raises final blocking ungoverned coverage from the executable flag, but its binding has an empty delta (v7 delta ['<AppendOnly fp> effect(pg.table("audit_events"))']); the control agrees.
vectors.refutation-introduced: v6 never introduces a refutation (H2 arm X): call-removed and base-reported-unchanged-code are preexisting and owed in v6 (v7: introduced, blocking). The control agrees.
vectors.rename-in-place: v6 gives pass with no loosening in rebound-to-h (it raises no L6 part at g); version 7 must raise L6 loosened at g, blocking.
vectors.scc-merge: v6 agrees on keys, introducedness, bindings and witnesses, but raises an owed, introduced coverage obligation for component m::C in both cases (version 6 asks coverage on unobservable channels), which also joins the merged contradiction's group (v6 g:3be4831a7296a6ce); version 7 raises no coverage (D3).
vectors.second-site: v6 agrees on keys, introducedness, severities, bindings and witnesses, but raises an extra owed coverage obligation for component m::K in every case (unobservable channel), which joins write2's group in other-identity (v6 g:58b0498f6b675650).
vectors.string-ordered-parameter: v6 accepts "250ms" at a leq-ordered parameter (no E-template; it orders strings by codepoint, agent/B2), giving owed instead of blocked.
vectors.summary-direct: v6 summaries are transitive: callee-reads-clock is blocked in v6 by an effects.upper contradiction witnessed through the format->stamp call (v7: pass). v6 also keys summary contradictions by {unit, atom} (v7: {code, atom}, A.4.4.8), so own-code-reads-clock has a different key in v6.
vectors.this-method-guard-helper: v6 ignores manifest refs: Req is tick alone, so helper-edited is stale but not introduced (owed) in v6, and helper-edited-judgment-cites-tick-only passes in v6 (v7: both blocked; binding cites (format, unit) too). The control agrees.
vectors.trusted-body-edit: v6 keeps the contradiction preexisting and owed in trusted-body-edited (marker count unchanged), so the verdict is owed instead of blocked; key and binding agree.
vectors.two-exceptions-earliest-expiry: v6 picks the exception matching the primary excluding claim: its debt row names te::AWaiver with 311 days (v7: te::ZWaiver, 30 days, owner te::dave, exceptions listing both); earliest-expired agrees (owed, no debt).
vectors.two-level-admit: v6 gives pass in both cases: its cone does not close over manifest refs and its introducedness reads only Req, so the two-levels-down admit raises nothing.
vectors.undeclared-hatch-kind: v6 raises its Hatch-clause contradiction in both cases: with subject atom Hatch<std::Trust> for the undeclared kind (ob:d5a8c93ac028ff4e) and against ts_ignore inside the boundary that allows it (ob:8857f02fa77e906b, blocking), so declared-allowed-kind-in-boundary is blocked in v6 instead of pass.
vectors.unsigned-manifest-identity: v6 has no manifest identity: it reads a DSSE-enveloped manifest as malformed and returns invalid with E-input errors for the three signed cases; v7 reads the envelopes, raises E-provider-missing for the unsigned and wrongly signed head manifests, and passes both-signed. no-identity-control agrees (pass).
